scope: All entity-backed actor meshes, authored origin and fresh initialized state, all five imported levels. Setup bounds and asset transforms use CastleWorld.instantiateActor; initialized transforms use syncActors(0). Temporary projectiles/debris and auxiliary Dungeon Max machine meshes are excluded.
method: For each pose: native baseline locate/sample; require the first world/brush trace to start solid (no crossed node), baseline null, and explicit existing five-point recovery in transformed cached setup bounds to return a valid sample. No dynamic lights. Legitimate zero-valued lightmaps remain valid.
